concept.title: A carers' support group
concept.shortdesc: As a carer, I need somewhere to meet other carers in the same situation, so that I feel less alone and can share what works.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-013). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Has reduced all outside commitments; encouraged to ask for something for herself.
A good result: Local groups for her kind of caring, with time, place and whether the person cared for can come or be looked after.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: Is there anything for me as well — somewhere to meet other carers?
